cases.title: Published Stages shows the correct columns and values
steps: Inspect the table headers and stage rows.
Check the stage with a ref_id.
Check the stage without a ref_id.
cases.expected: The table shows Stage Title, Pending Actions, Participants, Bidding Starts At, and Bidding Ends At. Stage Code is shown only when at least one row has a ref_id. Participants use the active/total format, missing values show 0, and missing dates show "-".
cases.setup: Use a project with one stage that has a ref_id, one stage without a ref_id, pending actions, and participant totals.
gaps: The fixed prepared project cannot supply both a stage with ref_id and a stage without ref_id, so the conditional Stage Code column and both row variants cannot be verified.

The prepared state does not specify pending actions or active participant counts, and no supported API-value assertion exposes those fields to verify their displayed values or the active/total format reliably.
The prepared state does not guarantee missing participant counts or missing dates, and catalog steps cannot create those conditions to verify the 0 and '-' fallbacks.

steps: Enter a vendor name in "Search participants".
